Rabindranath Tagore, The Home and the World, translated by Surendranath Tagore.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/rabindranath-tagore/the-home-and-the-world/surendranath-tagore

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Rabindranath Tagore, the author, died 1941 (Wikidata Q7241; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rabindranath_Tagore).
- Surendranath Tagore, the translator, died 1940 (Wikidata Q19361492; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Surendranath_Tagore).

First publication of the text used: 1919, the translation by Surendranath Tagore (SE colophon: 'The Home and the World was published in 1916 by Rabindranath Tagore. It was translated from Bengali in 1919 by Surendranath Tagore.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1919, before 1931. Works published before 1931 are in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin: the facts do not name one country of first publication. The possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa. Each of them has a term of life + 70 years or less for these deaths. The last person to die, Rabindranath Tagore, died in 1941, so the text enters the public domain in each of these countries on 1 January 2012. An unknown exact country, or simultaneous publication in two of them, changes nothing. The original Bengali work is under India's term, which is life + 60 years for Tagore, so it entered the public domain there on 1 January 2002.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."

Sources of these facts:
- SE colophon: The Home and the World was published in 1916 by Rabindranath Tagore. It was translated from Bengali in 1919 by Surendranath Tagore.
- Rabindranath Tagore: death year 1941 from the gathered facts (Wikidata Q7241; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rabindranath_Tagore).
- Surendranath Tagore: death year 1940 from the gathered facts (Wikidata Q19361492; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Surendranath_Tagore).
